recap.narration_text: Disability plates follow qualifying resident and. Household transportation exception allows two plate. Qualifying transport organizations may receive plates. An Illinois resident with a permanent disability may obtain disability plates for a vehicle titled to that resident. A household immediate-family member may obtain two disability-plate sets when the qualifying disabled person owns no vehicle and depends on others for transportation. Eligible organizations transporting people with disabilities may obtain disability plates.
